record.question: Which team became Asia cup Cricket Under-19 Champion?
record.explanation: ICC's 4 January 2014 final report records India Under-19 beating Pakistan by 40 runs. This is the edition immediately before the June 2014 exam. Historical exam context: 2014-06 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.icc-cricket.com/news/zol-samson-star-in-asia-cup-victory Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
